text:
melissa_csm: Morning team — WillowEdge private deployment readiness. Quick runthrough: VPN established but failing large payloads, KMS access errors in our logs, and CloudTrail not showing Redwood-managed events.

raj_net: On VPN, looks like MTU mismatch causing fragmentation drop on TCP. Ask customer to set tunnel MTU to 1400 and enable DF clear. Also need their ASA to allow NAT traversal and keepalive.

donna_sec: KMS errors: principal missing from key policy -> 'arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/redwood-service'. Also key grants not created for envelope decrypt, they uploaded an alias but grant step missing.

kevin_ops: We saw 403 on decrypt calls in logs from our side. Can someone paste the last 5 lines from their CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt? Also their S3 bucket for CloudTrail isn't configured to accept cross-account delivery (ACL), that blocks us from receiving management events.

harper_prod: Pasted snippet from customer support channel: `2025-02-10T08:12:03Z kms.amazonaws.com Decrypt arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:... 403` — they said they tried to re-create grants but might have used wrong CMK ID.

onboard-bot: Heads up: onboarding milestone 'security-ready' moves to 'at-risk' if not resolved within 72 hours. Renewal counsel alerted.

melissa_csm: Renewal note noted. Customer expresses concern about contract start if we miss 2025-02-17. Please prioritize.

raj_net: Workaround: I can add a temporary route and adjust MTU from our side for the change window, but customer must commit to firewall config changes. Proposed window: 2025-02-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Is that okay, WillowEdge? @harper_prod can confirm.

harper_prod: That window works for us. We'll ask their NOC to be available. I'll DM the NOC lead.

donna_sec: I'll write the exact KMS policy snippet and grant commands into the runbook. Sample grant:

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/willow-edge-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/redwood-service --operations Decrypt,Encrypt,GenerateDataKey
```

kevin_ops: Also, please enable management events in CloudTrail and add our logging account as a trusted delivery. I'll send the S3 prefix they need to use. Once enabled, run `aws cloudtrail get-event-selectors` to verify.

melissa_csm: Action owners: NET-402 (raj_net), KMS-271 (donna_sec), LOGS-99 (kevin_ops). ETA 48-72h. I'll update the onboarding checklist and flag renewal-risk if slips.

harper_prod: Feedback for docs: more examples for Terraform-managed CMKs and explicit grant flows would have saved us time. We can coauthor a short snippet for the runbook.

melissa_csm: Great — adding RUNBOOK-58 to docs. Any other blockers? If not, I'll close this thread and open the change window coordination thread closer to date.

harper_prod: No other blockers. Thanks.

jonathan_ops: (joining late) I'll be on-call during the window. Post the final Asana tasks and I got you.

melissa_csm: Thanks everyone. Closing loop — will reconvene after customer confirms firewall rules and KMS grant. :white_check_mark:
